questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Leiden is a very nice small study-town with a lot of young people, and the Leiden University is one of the best universities regarding History.

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: Very difficult

questions.answer: Correspondance with the Erasmus staff at the University.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: 100% successful, I guess I was lucky.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *

questions.answer: Seemed like a higher level and more serious.

questions.answer: The hospitality of the dutchies

questions.answer: Note that it can be a bit troublesome and difficult to get housing, money for travel etc. but it is all worth
